Read GWAS results file with specified columns

Source: R/read_data.R
read_gwas_file.Rd

The column names are taken from the configuration (`rsid_col`, `chr_col`, `pos_col`, `pval_col`); see [set_config()].

Usage

read_gwas_file(gwasfile, header = TRUE, sep = NULL)

Arguments

gwasfile

Path to the GWAS file (tab, comma or semicolon separated; may be gzipped)

header

Logical, whether the file contains a header row

sep

Separator used in the file. `NULL` (default) detects it automatically.

Value

A data frame with the standardised columns `rsid`, `chr`, `pos`, `p` and `rs` (`chr:pos` identifier).

Examples

gwas <- read_gwas_file(system.file("extdata", "gwas_area_ann19.csv.gz", package = "HaploTraitR"))
head(gwas)
